items.text:

B. Change the scanner resolution from 300DPI to 600DPI
C. Scan in full-colour instead of monochrome

Short QuestionsSSICTB0299_03A001E, 4, 2025
1.
Jayden wants to purchase a new printer for his mother.
(a)
Suggest two ways to connect the printer to the computer.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Suggest a use case where using a laser printer is better than an inkjet printer. Explain why.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a) Wired connection using USB;
Wireless connection using Wi-Fi
(b) Printing large amounts of document → Laser printer has a faster printing speed
Printing contracts / important documents → printouts are more durable / water resistant
--]
